pending.zh_CN: 请求已提交，仍需确认最终状态，当前不能视为已完成。
pending.en_US: The request has been submitted. Check the final status before treating it as complete.

messages.zh_CN: 本页包含 {{count}} 条可读消息。

empty_messages.zh_CN: 本页没有可展示的消息正文。
empty_messages.en_US: This page has no message text to display.

truncated.en_US: Only part of the content is shown in this detail.

omitted.zh_CN: 已过滤 {{count}} 条无正文或不可展示的消息。
omitted.en_US: {{count}} messages with no text or hidden content were filtered out.

partial_success.zh_CN: 部分文件处理失败，请查看各文件状态。
partial_success.en_US: Some files could not be processed. Check each file’s status.

more.zh_CN: 还有更多记录，本页不代表全部内容。
more.en_US: More records are available. This page does not contain all content.

no_more.zh_CN: 当前查询已无更多记录。
no_more.en_US: No more records are reported for this query.

error.default.zh_CN: 操作未完成，请检查权限或稍后重试。
error.default.en_US: The operation could not be completed. Check your access or try again later.

error.authorization_required.zh_CN: 当前会话缺少身份信息，请重新打开会话后重试。
error.authorization_required.en_US: Identity information is missing from this session. Reopen the session and try again.

error.authorization_failed.zh_CN: 当前账号无权访问此内容。
error.authorization_failed.en_US: Your account does not have access to this content.

error.service_rejected.zh_CN: 服务未接受本次操作，请检查目标内容与操作权限。
error.service_rejected.en_US: The service did not accept this operation. Check the target content and your access.

error.network_error.zh_CN: 暂时无法连接服务，请稍后重试。
error.network_error.en_US: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

error.outcome_unknown.zh_CN: 尚无法确认操作是否生效，请先查询当前状态，避免重复提交。
error.outcome_unknown.en_US: The outcome could not be confirmed. Check the current status before submitting again.

error.invalid_input_or_response.zh_CN: 操作参数或返回内容不符合要求，请核对后重试。
error.invalid_input_or_response.en_US: The request or response was invalid. Check the information and try again.

error.unexpected_error.zh_CN: 操作遇到问题，请稍后重试。
error.unexpected_error.en_US: The operation encountered a problem. Please try again later.

error.duplicate_file_id.zh_CN: 选择的文件存在重复，请移除重复项后重试。
error.duplicate_file_id.en_US: The selected files contain duplicates. Remove them and try again.
